title: Sidebar hide under a pointer on the left edge, then the edge reveal (Lawrence msg 29542: the hidden sidebar floated back; the top-row buttons jumped). Before: the float comes back after the hide. After: it stays hidden until the pointer leaves the edge and returns; the toggle, Back and Forward leave with the sidebar. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/sidebar-hide-edge-reveal.json --video

steps.title: Sidebar shown: the top row's even gaps
The pointer on the sidebar, at the window's left edge
Hide the sidebar with the pointer still on the edge
After the hide: the sidebar must stay hidden (Before: it floats back)
The pointer returns to the edge: the float slides in
The pointer leaves: the float slides out
